meta.title: Whale desktop pet
meta.description: Puts a small whale in a DSH interface overlay. Click to poke it, double-click to pat it, press and hold to hug it, and drag it anywhere; it blinks, naps, wanders, and talks at the right time of day. Turn off the whale-pet row under Plugins to hide it. Drawn with CSS only, with no network requests or data collection.
